id-20261012-news-3.title: New Foreign Minister Arrmanatha Nasir: The Test of 'Free and Active' Foreign Policy Amid West Asian Tensions and Trade Rivalries

segments.src: Pergantian di pucuk Kementerian Luar Negeri selalu menarik perhatian, tetapi waktunya kali ini terasa istimewa.
segments.tr: Changes at the helm of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs always attract attention, but the timing this time feels special.

segments.src: Pelantikan **Arrmanatha Nasir** sebagai Menteri Luar Negeri menggantikan **Sugiono** berlangsung ketika Indonesia sedang menimbang kerja sama pertahanan, pendanaan, dan perdagangan dengan banyak mitra sekaligus.
segments.tr: The inauguration of **Arrmanatha Nasir** as Minister of Foreign Affairs, replacing **Sugiono**, takes place as Indonesia is weighing defense, funding, and trade cooperation with many partners simultaneously.

segments.src: Di saat yang sama, ketegangan di kawasan Asia Barat dan persaingan dagang antarnegara besar membuat ruang gerak diplomasi semakin menuntut kehati-hatian.
segments.tr: At the same time, tensions in the West Asian region and trade rivalries between major powers make the room for diplomatic maneuver increasingly demanding of caution.

segments.src: Artikel ini tidak menilai pribadi siapa pun.
segments.tr: This article does not judge anyone personally.

segments.src: Tujuannya memetakan tantangan diplomasi yang paling mungkin terasa langsung bagi masyarakat dan dunia usaha, mulai dari harga energi hingga peluang ekspor.
segments.tr: Its purpose is to map out the diplomatic challenges that are most likely to be felt directly by the public and the business world, ranging from energy prices to export opportunities.

segments.src: ## Mengapa pergantian ini penting
segments.tr: ## Why this change is important

segments.src: Menteri luar negeri bukan sekadar juru bicara pemerintah di forum internasional.
segments.tr: The foreign minister is not just a government spokesperson in international forums.

segments.src: Posisi ini menjadi simpul yang menghubungkan kepentingan keamanan, ekonomi, dan kemanusiaan.
segments.tr: This position serves as a node connecting security, economic, and humanitarian interests.

segments.src: Arah komunikasi dengan negara mitra, pilihan kata dalam pernyataan resmi, hingga prioritas negosiasi akan sangat memengaruhi posisi Indonesia.
segments.tr: The direction of communication with partner countries, the choice of words in official statements, and negotiation priorities will greatly influence Indonesia's position.

segments.src: Arrmanatha Nasir dikenal sebagai diplomat karier yang pernah lama bertugas di lingkungan Kementerian Luar Negeri, termasuk sebagai juru bicara kementerian dan di sejumlah penugasan luar negeri.
segments.tr: Arrmanatha Nasir is known as a career diplomat who has served for a long time within the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, including as the ministry's spokesperson and in a number of overseas assignments.

segments.src: Latar belakang itu sering dibaca sebagai modal pemahaman tentang mekanisme diplomasi multilateral dan bilateral.
segments.tr: That background is often read as an asset for understanding multilateral and bilateral diplomatic mechanisms.

segments.src: Meski demikian, hasil kerja sesungguhnya baru dapat dinilai dari kebijakan dan capaian yang terukur dalam beberapa bulan ke depan.
segments.tr: However, the actual results of his work can only be judged by measurable policies and achievements in the coming months.

segments.src: ## Prinsip bebas aktif: bukan netral pasif
segments.tr: ## The 'free and active' principle: not passive neutrality

segments.src: Politik luar negeri bebas aktif sering disalahpahami sebagai sikap tidak berpihak pada apa pun.
segments.tr: The 'free and active' foreign policy is often misunderstood as a stance of not taking sides on anything.

segments.src: Padahal, "bebas" berarti Indonesia menentukan sikap berdasarkan kepentingan nasional dan prinsip yang dianut, tanpa terikat blok tertentu.
segments.tr: In fact, "free" means Indonesia determines its stance based on national interests and the principles it upholds, without being tied to a specific bloc.

segments.src: Adapun "aktif" berarti Indonesia ikut berkontribusi pada perdamaian dan ketertiban dunia, bukan sekadar menonton.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, "active" means Indonesia participates in contributing to world peace and order, not just watching.

segments.src: Ujian terbesarnya muncul ketika beberapa mitra penting memiliki kepentingan yang saling bersaing.
segments.tr: Its biggest test arises when several important partners have competing interests.

segments.src: Kerja sama pertahanan dengan satu negara dapat dibaca berbeda oleh negara lain.
segments.tr: Defense cooperation with one country can be read differently by another.

segments.src: Tawaran pendanaan infrastruktur dari satu pihak juga sering datang dengan syarat dan konsekuensi jangka panjang.
segments.tr: Offers of infrastructure funding from one party also often come with long-term conditions and consequences.

segments.src: Menjaga keseimbangan tanpa kehilangan arah menjadi pekerjaan harian diplomasi.
segments.tr: Maintaining balance without losing direction becomes the daily work of diplomacy.

segments.src: ## Tiga arena yang akan langsung diuji
segments.tr: ## Three arenas that will be immediately tested

segments.src: ### 1. Ketegangan Asia Barat dan harga energi
segments.tr: ### 1. West Asian tensions and energy prices

segments.src: Gejolak di Asia Barat berdampak nyata pada rantai pasok energi dan jalur pelayaran.
segments.tr: Turmoil in West Asia has a real impact on energy supply chains and shipping lanes.

segments.src: Ketika risiko meningkat, harga minyak mentah, biaya asuransi pengapalan, dan ongkos logistik cenderung ikut naik.
segments.tr: When risks increase, crude oil prices, shipping insurance costs, and logistics costs tend to rise as well.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia sebagai negara yang masih mengimpor sebagian kebutuhan bahan bakar minyak dan elpiji, hal ini bisa memengaruhi anggaran subsidi energi serta harga barang di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, as a country that still imports a portion of its fuel and LPG needs, this could affect the energy subsidy budget as well as domestic goods prices.

segments.src: Di sisi diplomatik, Indonesia memiliki sejumlah kepentingan sekaligus:
segments.tr: On the diplomatic side, Indonesia has a number of simultaneous interests:

segments.src: - Menjaga kesinambungan pasokan energi dan keamanan jalur dagang.
segments.tr: - Maintaining the continuity of energy supplies and the security of trade routes.

segments.src: - Menyuarakan prinsip kemanusiaan dan penghormatan terhadap hukum internasional.
segments.tr: - Voicing humanitarian principles and respect for international law.

segments.src: - Melindungi warga negara Indonesia, termasuk pekerja migran, jemaah, dan pelajar di kawasan terdampak.
segments.tr: - Protecting Indonesian citizens, including migrant workers, pilgrims, and students in affected areas.

segments.src: - Menjaga hubungan baik dengan negara-negara kawasan yang juga menjadi mitra dagang dan investasi.
segments.tr: - Maintaining good relations with regional countries that are also trade and investment partners.

segments.src: ### 2. Kerja sama pertahanan dan pendanaan
segments.tr: ### 2. Defense and funding cooperation

segments.src: Modernisasi alat utama sistem persenjataan serta kebutuhan pembiayaan pembangunan membuka pintu bagi banyak mitra.
segments.tr: The modernization of primary weapon systems and development financing needs open doors to many partners.

segments.src: Kementerian Luar Negeri berperan memastikan bahwa setiap kesepakatan sejalan dengan prinsip bebas aktif, transparan, dan tidak menciptakan ketergantungan berlebihan pada satu pemasok atau satu sumber dana.
segments.tr: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs plays a role in ensuring that every agreement is in line with the free and active principle, is transparent, and does not create excessive dependence on one supplier or one source of funds.

segments.src: Pertanyaan kuncinya sederhana namun penting: apakah kerja sama tersebut memperkuat kemandirian, seperti alih teknologi dan keterlibatan industri dalam negeri, atau justru menambah ketergantungan?
segments.tr: The key question is simple yet important: does the cooperation strengthen independence, such as through technology transfer and domestic industry involvement, or does it actually increase dependence?

segments.src: Jawabannya sering ditentukan di meja negosiasi, jauh sebelum kesepakatan diumumkan ke publik.
segments.tr: The answer is often determined at the negotiating table, long before the agreement is announced to the public.

segments.src: ### 3. Persaingan dagang dan peluang ekspor
segments.tr: ### 3. Trade rivalry and export opportunities

segments.src: Persaingan dagang antarnegara besar, termasuk tarif, pembatasan teknologi, dan perubahan aturan rantai pasok, menciptakan risiko sekaligus peluang.
segments.tr: Trade rivalry between major countries, including tariffs, technology restrictions, and changes to supply chain rules, creates both risks and opportunities.

segments.src: Perusahaan yang memindahkan atau mendiversifikasi produksi mencari lokasi baru, dan Indonesia berkepentingan menjadi salah satu tujuannya.
segments.tr: Companies that are relocating or diversifying production are looking for new locations, and Indonesia has an interest in becoming one of their destinations.

segments.src: Peluang itu tidak otomatis datang.
segments.tr: That opportunity does not come automatically.

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang biasanya menentukan:
segments.tr: Several things usually determine this:

segments.src: - **Akses pasar**: percepatan perjanjian dagang yang sedang dirundingkan dan pemanfaatan perjanjian yang sudah berlaku.
segments.tr: - **Market access**: acceleration of trade agreements currently under negotiation and utilization of agreements already in effect.

segments.src: - **Hilirisasi dan standar produk**: produk olahan bernilai tambah harus memenuhi standar keberlanjutan dan kualitas pasar tujuan.
segments.tr: - **Downstreaming and product standards**: value-added processed products must meet the sustainability and quality standards of the destination market.

segments.src: - **Diversifikasi tujuan ekspor**: mengurangi ketergantungan pada satu atau dua pasar utama.
segments.tr: - **Diversification of export destinations**: reducing dependence on one or two main markets.

segments.src: - **Diplomasi ekonomi**: membantu pelaku usaha, terutama UMKM, menembus hambatan nontarif di negara tujuan.
segments.tr: - **Economic diplomacy**: assisting business players, especially MSMEs, in overcoming non-tariff barriers in destination countries.

segments.src: ## Apa dampaknya bagi masyarakat
segments.tr: ## What is the impact on the public

segments.src: Isu diplomasi sering terasa jauh, padahal jejaknya sampai ke kehidupan sehari-hari:
segments.tr: Diplomatic issues often feel distant, even though their traces reach daily life:

segments.src: - **Harga energi dan kebutuhan pokok**: stabilitas kawasan penghasil energi memengaruhi harga bahan bakar dan biaya angkut.
segments.tr: - **Energy and staple food prices**: the stability of energy-producing regions affects fuel prices and transportation costs.

segments.src: - **Nilai tukar dan inflasi**: ketidakpastian global dapat memengaruhi arus modal dan nilai rupiah.
segments.tr: - **Exchange rates and inflation**: global uncertainty can affect capital flows and the value of the rupiah.

segments.src: - **Lapangan kerja**: peluang ekspor dan investasi baru berkaitan dengan pembukaan lapangan kerja di sektor manufaktur dan pengolahan.
segments.tr: - **Job opportunities**: new export and investment opportunities are related to job creation in the manufacturing and processing sectors.

segments.src: - **Perlindungan warga negara**: respons cepat terhadap krisis di luar negeri menentukan keselamatan WNI.
segments.tr: - **Citizen protection**: rapid response to crises abroad determines the safety of Indonesian citizens.

segments.src: ## Hal yang layak dipantau ke depan
segments.tr: ## Things worth monitoring going forward

segments.src: Alih-alih menilai terlalu dini, ada beberapa indikator yang dapat dipantau publik untuk membaca arah kebijakan luar negeri:
segments.tr: Instead of judging too early, there are several indicators that the public can monitor to read the direction of foreign policy:

segments.src: 1. **Prioritas yang disampaikan pada pidato awal dan pertemuan perdana** dengan mitra utama.
segments.tr: 1. **Priorities conveyed in the initial speech and inaugural meetings** with key partners.

segments.src: 2. **Konsistensi sikap** Indonesia di forum multilateral terkait isu kawasan.
segments.tr: 2. **Consistency of Indonesia's stance** in multilateral forums regarding regional issues.

segments.src: 3. **Kemajuan perundingan dagang** dan kerja sama ekonomi dengan berbagai mitra.
segments.tr: 3. **Progress of trade negotiations** and economic cooperation with various partners.

segments.src: 4. **Koordinasi lintas kementerian**, terutama dengan bidang pertahanan, perdagangan, dan keuangan.
segments.tr: 4. **Cross-ministerial coordination**, especially with the defense, trade, and finance sectors.

segments.src: 5. **Keterbukaan informasi** kepada publik mengenai arah dan alasan kebijakan penting.
segments.tr: 5. **Information transparency** to the public regarding the direction and reasons for important policies.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Pergantian menteri luar negeri bukan berarti perubahan arah secara otomatis.
segments.tr: A change in foreign minister does not mean an automatic change in direction.

segments.src: Prinsip bebas aktif tetap menjadi pedoman, sementara ujiannya terletak pada kemampuan menerjemahkan prinsip itu ke dalam keputusan konkret di tengah dunia yang semakin terfragmentasi.
segments.tr: The free and active principle remains the guide, while the test lies in the ability to translate that principle into concrete decisions in an increasingly fragmented world.

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat dan pelaku usaha, hal yang paling relevan adalah memantau bagaimana diplomasi diterjemahkan menjadi energi yang lebih terjangkau, pasar ekspor yang lebih terbuka, dan perlindungan yang lebih kuat bagi warga negara.
segments.tr: For the public and business players, the most relevant thing is to monitor how diplomacy is translated into more affordable energy, more open export markets, and stronger protection for citizens.

segments.src: *Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat analisis umum dan informatif, bukan nasihat investasi atau kebijakan.
segments.tr: *Note: This article is for general analysis and informational purposes, not investment or policy advice.

segments.src: Pembaca disarankan merujuk pada pernyataan resmi pemerintah dan sumber berita tepercaya untuk perkembangan terbaru.*
segments.tr: Readers are advised to refer to official government statements and trusted news sources for the latest developments.*

id-20261012-news-1.title: New National Police Chief Suyudi Ario Seto: What Is Being Tested in the Police Reform Agenda and Public Trust?

segments.src: Persetujuan DPR atas Suyudi Ario Seto sebagai Kapolri pengganti Listyo Sigit Prabowo menandai babak baru bagi institusi kepolisian.
segments.tr: The DPR's approval of Suyudi Ario Seto as the National Police Chief replacing Listyo Sigit Prabowo marks a new chapter for the police institution.

segments.src: Setiap pergantian pimpinan selalu disertai harapan, tetapi juga pertanyaan: perubahan apa yang benar-benar bisa dirasakan masyarakat?
segments.tr: Every change in leadership is always accompanied by hope, but also questions: what changes can truly be felt by the public?

segments.src: Artikel ini tidak menilai pribadi siapa pun, melainkan merangkum tolok ukur yang dapat dipakai publik untuk mengamati 100 hari pertama kepemimpinan baru.
segments.tr: This article does not judge anyone personally, but rather summarizes the benchmarks that the public can use to observe the first 100 days of the new leadership.

segments.src: ## Mengapa 100 hari pertama menjadi sorotan
segments.tr: ## Why the first 100 days are in the spotlight

segments.src: Periode 100 hari memang tidak cukup untuk menuntaskan reformasi struktural.
segments.tr: The 100-day period is indeed not enough to complete structural reform.

segments.src: Namun, rentang waktu ini lazim dipakai sebagai gambaran awal arah kebijakan: apa yang diprioritaskan, siapa yang dilibatkan, dan seberapa terbuka pimpinan terhadap evaluasi.
segments.tr: However, this timeframe is commonly used as an initial overview of policy direction: what is prioritized, who is involved, and how open the leadership is to evaluation.

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat, sinyal awal ini penting karena kepercayaan publik dibangun dari pengalaman sehari-hari, bukan semata dari pidato atau dokumen.
segments.tr: For the public, this initial signal is important because public trust is built from daily experience, not merely from speeches or documents.

segments.src: Perlu diingat pula bahwa kepolisian adalah institusi besar dengan jajaran yang tersebar dari tingkat Mabes hingga polsek.
segments.tr: It should also be remembered that the police is a large institution with ranks spread from the Headquarters level to the sector police (polsek).

segments.src: Perubahan di pucuk pimpinan baru berdampak nyata jika diterjemahkan menjadi instruksi, mekanisme kontrol, dan budaya kerja di lapangan.
segments.tr: Changes at the top leadership have a real impact if translated into instructions, control mechanisms, and work culture in the field.

segments.src: ## Tolok ukur yang bisa dipantau publik
segments.tr: ## Benchmarks that can be monitored by the public

segments.src: ### 1. Pengawasan internal dan akuntabilitas
segments.tr: ### 1. Internal supervision and accountability

segments.src: Salah satu ukuran paling mendasar adalah seberapa transparan proses penanganan dugaan pelanggaran oleh anggota.
segments.tr: One of the most fundamental measures is how transparent the process of handling alleged violations by members is.

segments.src: Beberapa pertanyaan yang relevan:
segments.tr: Some relevant questions:

segments.src: - Apakah perkembangan perkara etik dan disiplin dapat diketahui pelapor dan publik secara berkala?
segments.tr: - Can the progress of ethical and disciplinary cases be known by the complainant and the public periodically?

segments.src: - Apakah sanksi dijatuhkan secara konsisten, tanpa memandang pangkat?
segments.tr: - Are sanctions imposed consistently, regardless of rank?

segments.src: - Bagaimana koordinasi dengan lembaga pengawas eksternal seperti Kompolnas, Ombudsman, dan Komnas HAM, termasuk tindak lanjut atas rekomendasi mereka?
segments.tr: - How is the coordination with external supervisory bodies such as Kompolnas, the Ombudsman, and the National Commission on Human Rights (Komnas HAM), including the follow-up on their recommendations?

segments.src: Data agregat yang dipublikasikan secara rutin, misalnya jumlah laporan masyarakat, jumlah yang diproses, dan hasil akhirnya, akan membantu publik menilai kemajuan tanpa harus mengandalkan kesan.
segments.tr: Aggregate data published regularly, for example, the number of public reports, the number processed, and the final results, will help the public assess progress without having to rely on impressions.

segments.src: ### 2. Penanganan unjuk rasa dan pengamanan massa
segments.tr: ### 2. Handling of demonstrations and crowd control

segments.src: Kebebasan menyampaikan pendapat di muka umum dijamin konstitusi, sementara aparat berkewajiban menjaga ketertiban.
segments.tr: Freedom of expression in public is guaranteed by the constitution, while the authorities are obliged to maintain order.

segments.src: Menjaga keseimbangan keduanya adalah ujian yang berulang.
segments.tr: Maintaining the balance between the two is a recurring test.

segments.src: Indikator yang dapat dicermati antara lain:
segments.tr: Indicators that can be observed include:

segments.src: - Kejelasan prosedur pengamanan dan penggunaan kekuatan yang proporsional sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku.
segments.tr: - Clarity of security procedures and the use of force that is proportional according to applicable regulations.

segments.src: - Pendekatan dialog dan pencegahan sebelum eskalasi di lapangan.
segments.tr: - Dialogue and prevention approaches before escalation in the field.

segments.src: - Mekanisme evaluasi terbuka setelah suatu peristiwa, termasuk bila terdapat korban atau pihak yang dirugikan.
segments.tr: - Open evaluation mechanisms after an event, including if there are victims or parties who are harmed.

segments.src: - Perlindungan bagi jurnalis, pendamping hukum, dan petugas medis yang bertugas di sekitar aksi.
segments.tr: - Protection for journalists, legal companions, and medical personnel on duty around the action.

segments.src: ### 3. Kualitas pelayanan publik
segments.tr: ### 3. Quality of public service

segments.src: Bagi sebagian besar warga, wajah kepolisian adalah loket pelayanan, laporan kehilangan, pengurusan SIM atau SKCK, serta penanganan laporan di tingkat sektor.
segments.tr: For most citizens, the face of the police is the service counter, loss reports, processing of driver's licenses (SIM) or police clearance certificates (SKCK), as well as handling reports at the sector level.

segments.src: Karena itu, pembenahan layanan dasar sering menjadi penentu persepsi.
segments.tr: Therefore, improving basic services is often a determinant of perception.

segments.src: Hal yang dapat dipantau:
segments.tr: Things that can be monitored:

segments.src: - Kejelasan biaya resmi dan waktu penyelesaian layanan.
segments.tr: - Clarity of official fees and service completion times.

segments.src: - Kemudahan kanal pengaduan, baik tatap muka maupun daring.
segments.tr: - Ease of complaint channels, both face-to-face and online.

segments.src: - Kecepatan respons terhadap laporan, terutama kasus yang menyangkut keselamatan dan kekerasan terhadap perempuan serta anak.
segments.tr: - Speed of response to reports, especially cases involving safety and violence against women and children.

segments.src: - Konsistensi pelayanan antara kota besar dan daerah.
segments.tr: - Consistency of service between big cities and regions.

segments.src: ### 4. Profesionalisme penegakan hukum
segments.tr: ### 4. Professionalism in law enforcement

segments.src: Kepercayaan publik juga bergantung pada keyakinan bahwa hukum ditegakkan secara adil.
segments.tr: Public trust also depends on the belief that the law is enforced fairly.

segments.src: Ukuran yang relevan mencakup keterbukaan informasi perkembangan perkara (misalnya melalui SP2HP), kualitas penyidikan, serta kehati-hatian dalam penanganan perkara yang menyita perhatian masyarakat.
segments.tr: Relevant measures include transparency of information on case progress (for example through SP2HP), quality of investigation, and caution in handling cases that attract public attention.

segments.src: ### 5. Kesejahteraan dan pembinaan personel
segments.tr: ### 5. Personnel welfare and development

segments.src: Pembenahan institusi tidak dapat dilepaskan dari pembinaan anggota: rekrutmen yang bersih, pendidikan yang berkelanjutan, beban kerja yang wajar, dan dukungan kesehatan mental.
segments.tr: Institutional improvement cannot be separated from member development: clean recruitment, continuous education, reasonable workload, and mental health support.

segments.src: Personel yang dibina dengan baik cenderung lebih mampu bekerja profesional di lapangan.
segments.tr: Personnel who are well-developed tend to be more capable of working professionally in the field.

segments.src: ## Peran DPR, masyarakat sipil, dan media
segments.tr: ## The role of the DPR, civil society, and the media

segments.src: Persetujuan DPR bukan akhir dari pengawasan, melainkan awal dari fungsi kontrol yang berkelanjutan melalui rapat kerja, evaluasi anggaran, dan pembahasan kebijakan.
segments.tr: The DPR's approval is not the end of supervision, but the beginning of a continuous control function through working meetings, budget evaluations, and policy discussions.

segments.src: Masyarakat sipil, akademisi, dan media juga berperan menyediakan data, kajian, dan liputan yang akurat.
segments.tr: Civil society, academics, and the media also play a role in providing data, studies, and accurate coverage.

segments.src: Kritik yang berbasis fakta dan disampaikan secara konstruktif membantu institusi memperbaiki diri, sementara apresiasi yang proporsional memberi insentif bagi praktik yang baik.
segments.tr: Fact-based criticism delivered constructively helps the institution improve itself, while proportional appreciation provides incentives for good practices.

segments.src: ## Cara membaca perkembangan secara kritis
segments.tr: ## How to read developments critically

segments.src: Agar penilaian tidak terjebak pada kesan sesaat, publik dapat menerapkan beberapa langkah sederhana:
segments.tr: So that the assessment is not trapped in momentary impressions, the public can apply several simple steps:

segments.src: 1. **Pisahkan pernyataan dari tindakan.** Catat apa yang dijanjikan, lalu periksa apakah ada langkah konkret dan indikator yang bisa diverifikasi.
segments.tr: 1. **Separate statements from actions.** Note what is promised, then check if there are concrete steps and indicators that can be verified.

segments.src: 2. **Cari sumber yang beragam.** Bandingkan pernyataan resmi, laporan lembaga pengawas, dan liputan media yang kredibel.
segments.tr: 2. **Look for diverse sources.** Compare official statements, reports from supervisory bodies, and credible media coverage.

segments.src: 3. **Lihat pola, bukan satu peristiwa.** Satu kejadian tidak selalu mewakili keseluruhan institusi, baik untuk sisi positif maupun negatif.
segments.tr: 3. **Look at patterns, not just one event.** One incident does not always represent the entire institution, both for positive and negative sides.

segments.src: 4. **Perhatikan tindak lanjut.** Evaluasi yang baik terlihat dari perbaikan yang berlanjut, bukan hanya respons cepat saat sorotan tinggi.
segments.tr: 4. **Pay attention to follow-up.** Good evaluation is seen from continuous improvement, not just quick responses when the spotlight is high.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Pergantian Kapolri adalah momentum, bukan jaminan perubahan.
segments.tr: The change of the National Police Chief is a momentum, not a guarantee of change.

segments.src: Nilai sebenarnya akan terlihat dari konsistensi: apakah pengawasan internal makin kuat, unjuk rasa ditangani secara proporsional, dan layanan publik terasa lebih mudah serta bersih.
segments.tr: The true value will be seen from consistency: whether internal supervision is getting stronger, demonstrations are handled proportionally, and public services feel easier and cleaner.

segments.src: Dengan tolok ukur yang jelas dan pengamatan yang berimbang, 100 hari pertama dapat menjadi bahan evaluasi yang adil, baik bagi pimpinan baru maupun bagi masyarakat yang berhak atas kepolisian yang profesional dan dipercaya.
segments.tr: With clear benchmarks and balanced observation, the first 100 days can be fair evaluation material, both for the new leadership and for the public who are entitled to a professional and trusted police force.

id-20261012-intro-logistics-9.title: [Logistics #9] A Package from Surabaya to Jakarta Takes Just One Night, So Why Can the Last 3 Km Take a Full Day?

segments.src: > Perjalanan barang bukan satu garis lurus: ada sambungan antar-moda yang harus mulus, ada "kilometer terakhir" yang paling mahal per paketnya, dan ada soal matematika bernama VRP yang diam-diam menentukan jam berapa kurir mengetuk pintu Anda.
segments.tr: > Goods don't travel in a straight line: there are inter-modal connections that must be seamless, there's the "last kilometer" that costs the most per package, and there's a math problem called VRP that quietly determines the time a courier knocks on your door.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Kalau Anda melacak resi, biasanya yang terlihat cuma deretan status: *Paket telah dipickup* → *Dalam perjalanan ke kota tujuan* → *Sedang diantar kurir*.
segments.tr: If you track a receipt number, you usually only see a series of statuses: *Package picked up* → *On the way to the destination city* → *Out for delivery*.

segments.src: Di balik tiga baris itu ada tiga topik yang jadi inti manajemen transportasi modern.
segments.tr: Behind those three lines are three topics that form the core of modern transportation management.

segments.src: **1) Angkutan multimoda: satu perjalanan, banyak kendaraan**
segments.tr: **1) Multimodal transport: one journey, many vehicles**

segments.src: Barang jarang sampai tujuan dengan satu jenis kendaraan saja.
segments.tr: Goods rarely reach their destination on just one type of vehicle.

segments.src: Sekarung kopi dari Toraja bisa naik truk ke pelabuhan, naik kapal ke Surabaya, lalu naik truk lagi ke gudang di Sidoarjo.
segments.tr: A sack of coffee from Toraja can travel by truck to the port, by ship to Surabaya, then by truck again to a warehouse in Sidoarjo.

segments.src: Pemakaian lebih dari satu moda seperti ini disebut **angkutan multimoda**.
segments.tr: The use of more than one mode like this is called **multimodal transport**.

segments.src: Ada istilah tetangganya, **intermoda**, yang sering tertukar.
segments.tr: There is a neighboring term, **intermodal**, that is often confused with it.

segments.src: Bedanya bukan di jumlah moda, tapi di **kontrak dan tanggung jawab**:
segments.tr: The difference is not in the number of modes, but in **contracts and responsibility**:

segments.src: - **Intermoda**: barangnya (biasanya dalam kontainer) berpindah moda tanpa dibongkar isinya, tapi pengirim bisa berurusan dengan beberapa penyedia jasa dan beberapa dokumen.
segments.tr: - **Intermodal**: the goods (usually in a container) change modes without their contents being unloaded, but the shipper may deal with several service providers and several documents.

segments.src: - **Multimoda**: cukup **satu kontrak dan satu pihak yang bertanggung jawab** dari titik asal sampai titik tujuan, meski di lapangan dia menyewa truk, kereta, dan kapal milik orang lain. Di Indonesia, badan usaha yang menjalankan peran ini diatur lewat regulasi angkutan multimoda, dan yang menerbitkan satu dokumen pengangkutan untuk seluruh rute.
segments.tr: - **Multimodal**: only **one contract and one party responsible** from origin to destination, even though on the ground that party rents trucks, trains, and ships owned by others. In Indonesia, the business entity that performs this role is regulated through multimodal transport regulations, and it issues a single transport document for the entire route.

segments.src: Kenapa ini penting?
segments.tr: Why does this matter?

segments.src: Karena kalau barang rusak di titik sambungan antara kapal dan truk, pada skema multimoda pengirim tidak perlu ikut sidang saling tuding antar-vendor.
segments.tr: Because if goods are damaged at the transfer point between ship and truck, under a multimodal scheme the shipper doesn't have to join a dispute of finger-pointing between vendors.

segments.src: Ada satu alamat untuk komplain.
segments.tr: There is one address for complaints.

segments.src: Kunci efisiensi multimoda ada di **titik sambungan (transshipment)**.
segments.tr: The key to multimodal efficiency lies in the **transshipment point**.

segments.src: Kontainer standar dan palet adalah pahlawan tak terlihat di sini: karena ukurannya seragam, memindahkan muatan dari kapal ke truk cukup pakai crane dalam hitungan menit, bukan bongkar-muat karung satu per satu.
segments.tr: Standard containers and pallets are the unseen heroes here: because their sizes are uniform, moving cargo from ship to truck takes just a crane and a few minutes, rather than unloading sacks one by one.

segments.src: **2) Last mile: bagian terpendek, tapi paling boros**
segments.tr: **2) Last mile: the shortest segment, but the most wasteful**

segments.src: **Last mile** adalah ruas terakhir — dari gudang sortir kota ke pintu penerima.
segments.tr: The **last mile** is the final stretch — from the city sorting hub to the recipient's door.

segments.src: Panjangnya mungkin cuma 5–15 km, tapi berbagai studi logistik menyebut ruas ini menyerap kira-kira **30–50% dari total biaya pengiriman** sebuah paket.
segments.tr: It may be only 5–15 km long, yet various logistics studies say this segment absorbs roughly **30–50% of the total shipping cost** of a package.

segments.src: Kenapa semahal itu?
segments.tr: Why is it so expensive?

segments.src: Bandingkan dua ruas ini:
segments.tr: Compare these two segments:

segments.src: | | Line haul (Surabaya→Jakarta) | Last mile (hub→rumah) |
segments.tr: | | Line haul (Surabaya→Jakarta) | Last mile (hub→home) |

segments.src: | Muatan sekali jalan | ribuan paket | puluhan paket |
segments.tr: | Load per trip | thousands of packages | dozens of packages |

segments.src: | Jumlah berhenti | 1–2 kali | 40–100+ kali |
segments.tr: | Number of stops | 1–2 times | 40–100+ times |

segments.src: | Biaya dibagi ke | ribuan paket | segelintir paket |
segments.tr: | Cost shared across | thousands of packages | a handful of packages |

segments.src: Line haul itu "borongan": satu sopir, satu tangki solar, ribuan paket ikut menumpang, jadi biaya per paketnya kecil.
segments.tr: Line haul is "bulk": one driver, one tank of diesel, thousands of packages riding along, so the cost per package is small.

segments.src: Last mile itu eceran: kurir berhenti, parkir, cari alamat, telepon, nunggu penerima keluar — lalu ulangi 80 kali.
segments.tr: Last mile is retail: the courier stops, parks, looks for the address, makes a phone call, waits for the recipient to come out — then repeats it 80 times.

segments.src: Belum lagi **failed delivery** (penerima tidak di tempat), yang artinya seluruh biaya kunjungan itu terbuang dan harus diulang besok.
segments.tr: Not to mention **failed deliveries** (recipient not home), which means the entire cost of that visit is wasted and must be repeated tomorrow.

segments.src: Solusi yang dipakai industri hampir semuanya bertujuan mengurangi jumlah pemberhentian atau memastikan sekali antar langsung berhasil: titik ambil di minimarket dan agen (**PUDO** — *pick-up drop-off*), loker paket di apartemen, kurir motor untuk gang sempit, dan kesepakatan taruh di pos satpam.
segments.tr: Solutions used across the industry almost all aim to reduce the number of stops or ensure that a single delivery succeeds: pick-up points at minimarkets and agents (**PUDO** — *pick-up drop-off*), package lockers in apartments, motorbike couriers for narrow alleys, and agreements to leave packages at the security post.

segments.src: **3) VRP: siapa mengantar ke mana, dengan urutan apa?**
segments.tr: **3) VRP: who delivers to where, in what order?**

segments.src: Misal satu hub punya 5 mobil dan 120 titik antar hari ini.
segments.tr: Suppose one hub has 5 vans and 120 delivery points today.

segments.src: Pertanyaannya: paket mana masuk mobil mana, dan urutan kunjungannya bagaimana supaya total jarak paling pendek?
segments.tr: The questions are: which package goes on which van, and in what order should the stops be visited so that total distance is shortest?

segments.src: Itulah **Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP)**.
segments.tr: That is the **Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP)**.

segments.src: VRP adalah perluasan dari soal klasik "keliling semua kota sekali lalu pulang" (*Travelling Salesman Problem*), ditambah kenyataan lapangan: kendaraan punya **kapasitas** terbatas (versi ini disebut CVRP), pelanggan punya **jam terima** tertentu (VRPTW — *with time windows*), dan sopir punya jam kerja.
segments.tr: VRP is an extension of the classic "visit all cities once and return home" problem (the *Travelling Salesman Problem*), plus real-world conditions: vehicles have limited **capacity** (this version is called CVRP), customers have specific **receiving hours** (VRPTW — *with time windows*), and drivers have working hours.

segments.src: Masalahnya, jumlah kemungkinan rute meledak jauh lebih cepat daripada jumlah titiknya:
segments.tr: The problem is that the number of possible routes explodes much faster than the number of points:

segments.src: Jumlah urutan kunjungan untuk 20 titik = 19! / 2 ≈ 6 x 10^16 kemungkinan
segments.tr: Jumlah urutan kunjungan untuk 20 titik = 19! / 2 ≈ 6 x 10^16 kemungkinan

segments.src: Enam puluh juta miliar.
segments.tr: Sixty million billion.

segments.src: Mengecek satu per satu jelas mustahil, bahkan buat komputer.
segments.tr: Checking them one by one is clearly impossible, even for a computer.

segments.src: Makanya praktiknya orang tidak mencari jawaban *paling* optimal, tapi jawaban *cukup baik dan cepat didapat*, memakai **heuristik**.
segments.tr: So in practice, people don't look for the *most* optimal answer, but for an answer that is *good enough and found quickly*, using **heuristics**.

segments.src: Salah satu yang paling terkenal adalah *savings algorithm* Clarke-Wright, yang menghitung penghematan bila dua titik digabung ke satu rute:
segments.tr: One of the most famous is the Clarke-Wright *savings algorithm*, which calculates the savings if two points are combined into one route:

segments.src: S(i,j) = d(depot,i) + d(depot,j) - d(i,j)
segments.tr: S(i,j) = d(depot,i) + d(depot,j) - d(i,j)

segments.src: Terjemahan bebasnya: "seberapa banyak jarak yang dihemat kalau kurir tidak bolak-balik ke gudang untuk melayani i dan j secara terpisah".
segments.tr: Loosely translated: "how much distance is saved if the courier doesn't go back and forth to the warehouse to serve i and j separately".

segments.src: Pasangan dengan nilai `S` terbesar digabung lebih dulu, selama kapasitas kendaraan masih muat.
segments.tr: The pair with the largest `S` value is merged first, as long as vehicle capacity still fits.

segments.src: Sistem modern lalu memoles hasilnya dengan metode pencarian lanjutan dan data lalu lintas real-time.
segments.tr: Modern systems then polish the result with advanced search methods and real-time traffic data.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Everyday Life

segments.src: Anda pesan sepatu dari penjual di Surabaya, dikirim ke rumah di Bekasi, ongkir tertulis Rp 22.000.
segments.tr: You order shoes from a seller in Surabaya, delivered to a home in Bekasi, with shipping listed as Rp 22,000.

segments.src: **Malam hari 1.** Kurir mengambil paket dari toko dan membawanya ke gudang sortir Surabaya.
segments.tr: **Night of day 1.** A courier picks up the package from the store and takes it to the Surabaya sorting warehouse.

segments.src: Paket Anda digabung dengan ribuan paket lain ke arah Jabodetabek, dimasukkan ke kontainer, lalu berangkat lewat jalur darat atau kereta barang relasi Surabaya–Jakarta.
segments.tr: Your package is combined with thousands of other packages heading to Greater Jakarta, loaded into a container, and departs via road or freight train on the Surabaya–Jakarta route.

segments.src: Ini bagian **multimoda/line haul** — biaya solar dan sopir sekitar jutaan rupiah dibagi ribuan paket, jadi porsi paket Anda mungkin hanya beberapa ribu rupiah untuk jarak ~800 km.
segments.tr: This is the **multimodal/line haul** part — diesel and driver costs of roughly millions of rupiah are divided among thousands of packages, so your share may be only a few thousand rupiah for a distance of ~800 km.

segments.src: **Pagi hari 2.** Kontainer bongkar di hub Jakarta Timur, paket disortir per kecamatan, lalu dikirim ke pos kecil di Bekasi.
segments.tr: **Morning of day 2.** The container is unloaded at the East Jakarta hub, packages are sorted by subdistrict, and then sent to a small post in Bekasi.

segments.src: Sampai sini semuanya masih "borongan" dan relatif murah.
segments.tr: Up to this point everything is still "bulk" and relatively cheap.

segments.src: **Siang hari 2.** Di sinilah biaya berpindah.
segments.tr: **Afternoon of day 2.** This is where the cost shifts.

segments.src: Seorang kurir motor membawa sekitar 80 paket untuk beberapa kelurahan sekaligus.
segments.tr: A motorbike courier carries about 80 packages for several villages at once.

segments.src: Aplikasinya sudah menyusun urutan pengantaran — itu output VRP versi nyata: kapasitas motor terbatas, ada alamat yang minta diantar setelah jam 5 sore (time window), ada gang yang macet jam pulang sekolah.
segments.tr: The app has already arranged the delivery sequence — that is the real-world VRP output: motorbike capacity is limited, some addresses request delivery after 5 PM (time window), and some alleys are jammed at school dismissal time.

segments.src: Paket Anda kebetulan berada di urutan ke-63.
segments.tr: Your package happens to be at position 63.

segments.src: **Sore hari 2.** Kurir sampai, tidak ada orang di rumah.
segments.tr: **Evening of day 2.** The courier arrives, but no one is home.

segments.src: Satu kunjungan itu — bensin, waktu, tenaga — hangus.
segments.tr: That one visit — fuel, time, effort — is wasted.

segments.src: Besok dia harus datang lagi, dan biaya last mile paket Anda praktis berlipat, meski ongkir yang Anda bayar tetap Rp 22.000.
segments.tr: Tomorrow they must come again, and the last-mile cost of your package practically doubles, even though the shipping fee you paid remains Rp 22,000.

segments.src: Perusahaan yang menanggung selisihnya.
segments.tr: The company bears the difference.

segments.src: Sekarang jelas kenapa penyedia jasa gencar mendorong opsi "ambil di Alfamart/Indomaret terdekat" atau loker paket apartemen: satu pemberhentian bisa menyelesaikan 30 paket sekaligus, dan tidak ada risiko rumah kosong.
segments.tr: Now it's clear why service providers push so hard for the "pick up at the nearest Alfamart/Indomaret" option or apartment package lockers: one stop can complete 30 packages at once, and there's no risk of an empty house.

segments.src: Bagi Anda itu terasa merepotkan; bagi mereka, itu memangkas komponen biaya terbesar dalam seluruh rantai.
segments.tr: For you, it feels like a hassle; for them, it cuts the biggest cost component in the entire chain.

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## Three-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. **Multimoda** bukan sekadar "pakai banyak kendaraan" — intinya satu kontrak dan satu pihak yang bertanggung jawab penuh dari asal ke tujuan; efisiensinya ditentukan oleh kemulusan titik sambungan antar-moda.
segments.tr: 1. **Multimodal** is not simply "using many vehicles" — its essence is one contract and one party fully responsible from origin to destination; efficiency depends on the smoothness of the intermodal transfer points.

segments.src: 2. **Last mile** adalah ruas terpendek tapi termahal (kerap 30–50% total biaya), karena biaya kunjungan tidak bisa dibagi ke banyak paket dan pengantaran gagal harus diulang.
segments.tr: 2. **Last mile** is the shortest segment but the most expensive (often 30–50% of total cost), because visit costs cannot be shared across many packages and failed deliveries must be repeated.

segments.src: 3. **VRP** menjawab "mobil mana, titik mana, urutan apa"; karena kombinasinya meledak secara faktorial, industri memakai heuristik untuk mendapat rute yang cukup baik dalam hitungan detik, bukan rute sempurna dalam hitungan tahun.
segments.tr: 3. **VRP** answers "which vehicle, which points, what order"; because the combinations explode factorially, the industry uses heuristics to get a good-enough route in seconds, not a perfect route in years.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.src: Apa pembeda utama angkutan multimoda dari intermoda?**
segments.tr: What is the key difference between multimodal and intermodal transport?**

segments.src: a) Jumlah jenis kendaraan yang dipakai
segments.tr: a) The number of vehicle types used

segments.src: b) Adanya satu kontrak dan satu pihak yang bertanggung jawab penuh sepanjang rute
segments.tr: b) The existence of one contract and one party fully responsible along the route

segments.src: c) Jenis barang yang boleh diangkut
segments.tr: c) The type of goods that may be transported

segments.src: d) Jarak tempuh minimum
segments.tr: d) The minimum travel distance

segments.src: (Benar/Salah)** Karena jaraknya paling pendek, last mile biasanya menjadi komponen termurah dalam biaya pengiriman paket.
segments.tr: (True/False)** Because its distance is the shortest, last mile is usually the cheapest component of parcel shipping cost.

segments.src: Mengapa perusahaan logistik memakai heuristik (bukan mencari solusi paling optimal) untuk menyusun rute harian?**
segments.tr: Why do logistics companies use heuristics (rather than seeking the most optimal solution) to build daily routes?**

segments.src: a) Karena komputer tidak mampu menghitung jarak antar-titik
segments.tr: a) Because computers cannot calculate distances between points

segments.src: b) Karena jumlah kemungkinan rute tumbuh sangat cepat sehingga mustahil dicek semuanya dalam waktu operasional
segments.tr: b) Because the number of possible routes grows so fast that it is impossible to check them all within operational time

segments.src: c) Karena heuristik selalu menghasilkan rute terpendek yang mungkin
segments.tr: c) Because heuristics always produce the shortest possible route

segments.src: d) Karena aturan pemerintah melarang penggunaan solusi optimal
segments.tr: d) Because government regulations prohibit the use of optimal solutions

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Term of the Day

segments.src: - **Angkutan multimoda** — pengangkutan dengan minimal dua moda berbeda di bawah satu kontrak dan satu penanggung jawab dari titik asal hingga tujuan.
segments.tr: - **Multimodal transport** — transport using at least two different modes under one contract and one responsible party from origin to destination.

segments.src: - **Line haul** — ruas angkutan jarak jauh antar-kota/antar-hub yang mengangkut muatan dalam volume besar sekaligus.
segments.tr: - **Line haul** — the long-distance transport segment between cities/hubs that carries large volumes of cargo at once.

segments.src: - **Last mile** — ruas terakhir dari hub lokal ke tangan penerima; porsi biaya per paket paling besar.
segments.tr: - **Last mile** — the final segment from the local hub to the recipient's hands; the largest share of cost per package.

segments.src: - **PUDO (pick-up drop-off point)** — titik ambil/serah paket seperti agen atau minimarket, dipakai untuk menggabungkan banyak pengantaran dalam satu pemberhentian.
segments.tr: - **PUDO (pick-up drop-off point)** — a pick-up/drop-off point for packages such as an agent or minimarket, used to combine many deliveries into one stop.

segments.src: - **VRP (Vehicle Routing Problem)** — persoalan menentukan pembagian muatan dan urutan kunjungan sejumlah kendaraan agar total biaya/jarak minimum, dengan batasan kapasitas dan waktu.
segments.tr: - **VRP (Vehicle Routing Problem)** — the problem of determining the allocation of loads and visit sequence for a number of vehicles so that total cost/distance is minimized, subject to capacity and time constraints.

segments.src: - **Time window** — rentang jam saat penerima bersedia atau bisa menerima barang; menjadi batasan tambahan dalam penyusunan rute.
segments.tr: - **Time window** — the range of hours during which a recipient is willing or able to receive goods; an additional constraint in route planning.

segments.src: *Jawaban:*
segments.tr: *Answers:*

segments.src: b — Multimoda dan intermoda sama-sama memakai lebih dari satu moda.
segments.tr: b — Multimodal and intermodal both use more than one mode.

segments.src: Yang membedakan adalah struktur kontrak dan tanggung jawabnya: multimoda cukup satu kontrak dengan satu pihak penanggung jawab untuk seluruh rute.*
segments.tr: What distinguishes them is the structure of contracts and responsibility: multimodal requires only one contract with one responsible party for the entire route.*

segments.src: Salah — Justru sebaliknya.
segments.tr: False — Quite the opposite.

segments.src: Biaya last mile tidak bisa dibagi ke banyak paket (puluhan pemberhentian, sedikit paket per titik) dan sering membengkak karena pengantaran gagal, sehingga kerap menyerap 30–50% total biaya pengiriman.*
segments.tr: Last-mile costs cannot be shared across many packages (dozens of stops, few packages per point) and often balloon due to failed deliveries, so they frequently absorb 30–50% of total shipping cost.*

segments.src: b — Untuk 20 titik saja kemungkinan urutannya sudah sekitar 6 x 10^16.
segments.tr: b — For just 20 points, the number of possible sequences is already about 6 x 10^16.

segments.src: Heuristik seperti Clarke-Wright tidak menjamin hasil paling optimal, tapi memberi rute yang cukup baik dalam hitungan detik — dan itu yang dibutuhkan gudang sortir tiap pagi.*
segments.tr: Heuristics like Clarke-Wright do not guarantee the most optimal result, but provide a good-enough route in seconds — which is what a sorting warehouse needs every morning.*

id-20261012-news-2.title: M6.1 Earthquake in Southwest Sumba: Why the NTT Region is Prone and What Residents Need to Prepare

segments.src: Gempa berkekuatan magnitudo 6,1 yang mengguncang perairan selatan Sumba Barat Daya, Nusa Tenggara Timur (NTT), dilaporkan tidak berpotensi tsunami.
segments.tr: An earthquake with a magnitude of 6.1 that shook the waters south of Southwest Sumba, East Nusa Tenggara (NTT), was reported to have no tsunami potential.

segments.src: Kabar itu melegakan, tetapi peristiwa ini juga menjadi pengingat bahwa NTT berada di kawasan dengan aktivitas tektonik yang tinggi.
segments.tr: That news is a relief, but this event also serves as a reminder that NTT is located in a region with high tectonic activity.

segments.src: Artikel ini membahas mengapa wilayah tersebut rawan gempa, bagaimana membaca informasi dari BMKG, seberapa siap bangunan sekolah, dan langkah sederhana yang bisa dilakukan keluarga.
segments.tr: This article discusses why the region is prone to earthquakes, how to read information from BMGK, how prepared school buildings are, and simple steps families can take.

segments.src: > Catatan: Angka magnitudo, kedalaman, dan titik pusat gempa dapat diperbarui oleh BMKG setelah analisis lanjutan. Rujuklah selalu kanal resmi BMKG untuk data terbaru.
segments.tr: > Note: Magnitude, depth, and epicenter numbers may be updated by BMGK after further analysis. Always refer to official BMGK channels for the latest data.

segments.src: ## Mengapa NTT Rawan Gempa?
segments.tr: ## Why Is NTT Prone to Earthquakes?

segments.src: Kepulauan Nusa Tenggara berada di zona pertemuan lempeng tektonik.
segments.tr: The Nusa Tenggara islands are located in a tectonic plate convergence zone.

segments.src: Lempeng Indo-Australia bergerak ke utara dan menunjam ke bawah lempeng di sisi utaranya melalui zona subduksi di selatan Nusa Tenggara.
segments.tr: The Indo-Australian Plate moves northward and subducts beneath the plate on its northern side through a subduction zone south of Nusa Tenggara.

segments.src: Pergerakan ini terjadi terus-menerus, dan energi yang tertahan sewaktu-waktu dilepaskan sebagai gempa bumi.
segments.tr: This movement occurs continuously, and the trapped energy is at times released as an earthquake.

segments.src: Selain zona subduksi di selatan, sejumlah sesar aktif di daratan dan di laut sekitar Flores, Sumba, Timor, dan Alor juga dapat memicu gempa.
segments.tr: In addition to the southern subduction zone, a number of active faults on land and in the seas around Flores, Sumba, Timor, and Alor can also trigger earthquakes.

segments.src: Karena itu, gempa di perairan selatan Sumba Barat Daya bukan kejadian yang aneh secara geologis.
segments.tr: Therefore, earthquakes in the waters south of Southwest Sumba are not a geologically strange occurrence.

segments.src: Wilayah ini memang tercatat beberapa kali mengalami gempa signifikan.
segments.tr: This region has indeed been recorded as experiencing significant earthquakes several times.

segments.src: Sejarah memberi pelajaran penting.
segments.tr: History provides an important lesson.

segments.src: Gempa besar Sumba pada Agustus 1977 dan gempa Flores pada Desember 1992 sama-sama diikuti tsunami dan menimbulkan kerusakan serta korban.
segments.tr: The major Sumba earthquake in August 1977 and the Flores earthquake in December 1992 were both followed by tsunamis and caused damage and casualties.

segments.src: Peristiwa-peristiwa itu menunjukkan bahwa kesiapsiagaan tidak boleh berhenti saat satu gempa berlalu tanpa dampak besar.
segments.tr: These events show that preparedness must not stop when one earthquake passes without major impact.

segments.src: ## Membaca Informasi BMKG dengan Benar
segments.tr: ## Reading BMGK Information Correctly

segments.src: Setelah gempa terjadi, BMKG biasanya merilis informasi singkat.
segments.tr: After an earthquake occurs, BMGK usually releases brief information.

segments.src: Memahami komponennya membantu warga bereaksi tepat dan tidak mudah terpengaruh kabar yang belum jelas.
segments.tr: Understanding its components helps residents react appropriately and not be easily influenced by unclear news.

segments.src: - **Magnitudo** menunjukkan kekuatan sumber gempa. Angka ini satu nilai untuk satu kejadian.
segments.tr: - **Magnitude** indicates the strength of the earthquake source. This number is one value for one event.

segments.src: - **Kedalaman** menunjukkan seberapa dalam pusat gempa. Gempa dangkal (kurang dari sekitar 60 km) cenderung terasa lebih kuat di permukaan dibanding gempa dalam dengan magnitudo sama.
segments.tr: - **Depth** indicates how deep the earthquake center is. Shallow earthquakes (less than about 60 km) tend to feel stronger at the surface compared to deep earthquakes with the same magnitude.

segments.src: - **Lokasi episenter** menunjukkan titik di permukaan di atas pusat gempa, biasanya dinyatakan dalam arah dan jarak dari kota atau kabupaten terdekat.
segments.tr: - **Epicenter location** indicates the point on the surface above the earthquake center, usually stated in direction and distance from the nearest city or regency.

segments.src: - **Potensi tsunami** menyatakan apakah gempa berpeluang memicu gelombang. Pernyataan "tidak berpotensi tsunami" berarti hasil pemodelan BMKG tidak menunjukkan ancaman gelombang yang signifikan.
segments.tr: - **Tsunami potential** states whether the earthquake has the chance to trigger waves. The statement "no tsunami potential" means BMGK modeling results do not show a significant wave threat.

segments.src: - **Skala intensitas (MMI)** menggambarkan seberapa kuat guncangan dirasakan di suatu tempat. Nilainya bisa berbeda antarwilayah. Guncangan di dekat pusat gempa umumnya lebih kuat.
segments.tr: - **Intensity scale (MMI)** describes how strongly the shaking is felt in a place. The value can differ between regions. Shaking near the earthquake center is generally stronger.

segments.src: - **Gempa susulan** dapat terjadi beberapa jam hingga hari setelah gempa utama. Sebagian terasa lemah, tetapi sebagian dapat cukup kuat untuk merusak bangunan yang sudah retak.
segments.tr: - **Aftershocks** can occur several hours to days after the main earthquake. Some feel weak, but some can be strong enough to damage buildings that are already cracked.

segments.src: Pemberitahuan "tidak berpotensi tsunami" tidak berarti guncangan tidak berbahaya.
segments.tr: The notification of "no tsunami potential" does not mean the shaking is not dangerous.

segments.src: Gempa bermagnitudo 6 tetap dapat merusak bangunan yang konstruksinya lemah, terutama bila lokasinya dangkal dan dekat permukiman.
segments.tr: A magnitude 6 earthquake can still damage buildings with weak construction, especially if the location is shallow and close to settlements.

segments.src: ### Sumber Informasi yang Dapat Dipercaya
segments.tr: ### Trusted Sources of Information

segments.src: Gunakan kanal resmi: situs dan aplikasi **InfoBMKG**, media sosial resmi BMKG, serta pengumuman dari BPBD setempat.
segments.tr: Use official channels: the **InfoBMKG** website and application, official BMGK social media, and announcements from local BPBD.

segments.src: Hindari meneruskan pesan berantai atau tangkapan layar yang tidak jelas asalnya.
segments.tr: Avoid forwarding chain messages or screenshots with unclear origins.

segments.src: Informasi palsu tentang tsunami atau "gempa susulan lebih besar" sering menimbulkan kepanikan yang justru berbahaya.
segments.tr: False information about tsunamis or "larger aftershocks" often causes panic which is actually dangerous.

segments.src: ## Kesiapan Bangunan Sekolah
segments.tr: ## School Building Readiness

segments.src: Sekolah adalah tempat ratusan anak berkumpul setiap hari, sehingga keamanan bangunannya perlu mendapat perhatian khusus.
segments.tr: Schools are places where hundreds of children gather every day, so their building security needs special attention.

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang sebaiknya diperiksa pengelola sekolah dan pemerintah daerah:
segments.tr: Several things school managers and local governments should check:

segments.src: 1. **Kondisi struktur.** Periksa retakan pada dinding, kolom, dan balok, serta tanda-tanda pondasi bergeser setelah guncangan. Retak yang melebar atau berpola menyilang perlu diperiksa oleh tenaga ahli sebelum ruang kembali dipakai.
segments.tr: 1. **Structural condition.** Check for cracks in walls, columns, and beams, as well as signs of shifted foundations after shaking. Widening or cross-patterned cracks need to be checked by experts before rooms are used again.

segments.src: 2. **Mutu konstruksi.** Bangunan tahan gempa membutuhkan tulangan yang memadai, sambungan yang kuat, dan material yang sesuai standar. Bangunan lama yang belum pernah dievaluasi perlu dinilai kelayakannya.
segments.tr: 2. **Construction quality.** Earthquake-resistant buildings require adequate reinforcement, strong joints, and standard-compliant materials. Old buildings that have not been evaluated need their feasibility assessed.

segments.src: 3. **Elemen nonstruktural.** Lemari, rak buku, papan tulis, plafon, dan lampu yang tidak terpasang kuat dapat jatuh dan melukai siswa. Pengikatan sederhana ke dinding sering kali sangat membantu.
segments.tr: 3. **Non-structural elements.** Cabinets, bookshelves, blackboards, ceilings, and lights that are not firmly installed can fall and injure students. Simple strapping to the wall is often very helpful.

segments.src: 4. **Jalur dan titik kumpul.** Pintu harus mudah dibuka ke arah luar, koridor tidak terhalang, dan lapangan terbuka ditetapkan sebagai titik kumpul yang jauh dari bangunan tinggi atau tiang.
segments.tr: 4. **Evacuation routes and assembly points.** Doors must open easily outward, corridors must be unobstructed, and open fields designated as assembly points far from tall buildings or poles.

segments.src: 5. **Latihan evakuasi.** Simulasi berkala membuat guru dan siswa terbiasa berlindung dengan benar dan berpindah dengan tertib.
segments.tr: 5. **Evacuation drills.** Regular simulations make teachers and students accustomed to taking cover correctly and moving in an orderly manner.

segments.src: Program Satuan Pendidikan Aman Bencana (SPAB) dari pemerintah dapat menjadi acuan.
segments.tr: The government's Disaster Safe Education Unit (SPAB) program can be a reference.

segments.src: Sekolah di kawasan pesisir sebaiknya juga mengenali jalur evakuasi tsunami dan titik aman yang lebih tinggi.
segments.tr: Schools in coastal areas should also recognize tsunami evacuation routes and higher safe points.

segments.src: ## Langkah Mitigasi di Tingkat Keluarga
segments.tr: ## Mitigation Steps at the Family Level

segments.src: Kesiapsiagaan tidak harus mahal atau rumit.
segments.tr: Preparedness does not have to be expensive or complicated.

segments.src: Beberapa langkah berikut dapat dilakukan dari rumah.
segments.tr: The following steps can be done from home.

segments.src: ### Sebelum gempa
segments.tr: ### Before an earthquake

segments.src: - **Kenali rumah Anda.** Periksa apakah ada dinding yang retak, atap yang berat, atau perabot tinggi yang mudah roboh. Ikat lemari dan pindahkan barang berat ke rak bawah.
segments.tr: - **Get to know your house.** Check if there are cracked walls, heavy roofs, or tall furniture that easily tips over. Tie up cabinets and move heavy items to lower shelves.

segments.src: - **Siapkan tas siaga.** Isi dengan air minum, makanan tahan lama, senter, baterai cadangan, obat pribadi, salinan dokumen penting, uang tunai, dan peluit.
segments.tr: - **Prepare an emergency bag.** Fill it with drinking water, long-lasting food, flashlights, spare batteries, personal medicine, copies of important documents, cash, and a whistle.

segments.src: - **Sepakati rencana keluarga.** Tentukan titik kumpul di luar rumah dan siapa yang menjemput anak bila gempa terjadi saat jam sekolah.
segments.tr: - **Agree on a family plan.** Determine an assembly point outside the home and who will pick up the children if an earthquake happens during school hours.

segments.src: - **Simpan nomor penting.** Catat kontak BPBD, puskesmas, dan anggota keluarga. Layanan darurat BNPB dapat dihubungi melalui nomor 117.
segments.tr: - **Save important numbers.** Record contacts for BPBD, community health centers, and family members. BNPB emergency services can be reached via number 117.

segments.src: ### Saat gempa
segments.tr: ### During an earthquake

segments.src: - **Jatuhkan diri, berlindung, dan bertahan (drop, cover, hold on).** Berlindunglah di bawah meja yang kokoh dan lindungi kepala serta leher.
segments.tr: - **Drop, cover, hold on.** Take cover under a sturdy desk and protect your head and neck.

segments.src: - **Jauhi kaca, lemari, dan benda yang dapat jatuh.**
segments.tr: - **Stay away from glass, cabinets, and objects that can fall.**

segments.src: - **Jangan berlari keluar saat guncangan masih terjadi.** Banyak cedera disebabkan puing yang jatuh saat orang mencoba keluar.
segments.tr: - **Do not run outside while shaking is still happening.** Many injuries are caused by falling debris when people try to go outside.

segments.src: - **Bila di luar ruangan,** menjauhlah dari bangunan, tiang listrik, dan pohon besar.
segments.tr: - **If outdoors,** stay away from buildings, power poles, and large trees.

segments.src: - **Bila di pantai dan guncangan terasa kuat atau lama,** segera menuju tempat yang lebih tinggi tanpa menunggu pemberitahuan, kecuali ada informasi resmi yang menyatakan aman.
segments.tr: - **If at the beach and shaking feels strong or lasts long,** immediately head to higher ground without waiting for notification, unless there is official information stating it is safe.

segments.src: ### Setelah gempa
segments.tr: - **Check the condition of yourself and your family,** then provide first aid if necessary.

segments.src: - **Periksa kondisi diri dan keluarga,** lalu beri pertolongan pertama bila perlu.
segments.tr: - **Be aware of aftershocks.** Avoid entering buildings that look damaged.

segments.src: - **Waspadai gempa susulan.** Hindari memasuki bangunan yang tampak rusak.
segments.tr: - **Turn off electricity and shut off gas flow** if there is damage, and do not light a fire if gas is smelled.

segments.src: - **Matikan listrik dan tutup aliran gas** bila ada kerusakan, dan jangan menyalakan api bila tercium bau gas.
segments.tr: - **Use text messages** instead of phone calls so the network is not congested.

segments.src: - **Gunakan pesan teks** alih-alih panggilan telepon agar jaringan tidak padat.
segments.tr: - **Follow officer directions** and official information before returning home.

segments.src: - **Ikuti arahan petugas** dan informasi resmi sebelum kembali ke rumah.
segments.tr: ## Lessons from Every Shaking

segments.src: ## Pelajaran dari Setiap Guncangan
segments.tr: The M6.1 earthquake in south Southwest Sumba may not have posed a tsunami threat, but it reminds us that NTT lives alongside real tectonic risks.

segments.src: Gempa M6,1 di selatan Sumba Barat Daya mungkin tidak menimbulkan ancaman tsunami, tetapi ia mengingatkan bahwa NTT hidup berdampingan dengan risiko tektonik yang nyata.
segments.tr: The resilience of a community is not determined by the size of a single earthquake, but by how ready residents, schools, and local governments are before the next shaking comes.

segments.src: Ketangguhan sebuah komunitas tidak ditentukan oleh besar-kecilnya satu gempa, melainkan oleh seberapa siap warga, sekolah, dan pemerintah daerah sebelum guncangan berikutnya datang.
segments.tr: Start with small things: check your house, discuss evacuation plans with family, and follow information from official channels.

segments.src: Mulailah dari hal kecil: periksa rumah, bicarakan rencana evakuasi dengan keluarga, dan ikuti informasi dari kanal resmi.
segments.tr: Simple preparations today can mean a lot when an emergency actually happens.

segments.src: Persiapan sederhana hari ini dapat sangat berarti ketika situasi darurat benar-benar terjadi.
segments.tr: Simple preparations today can mean a lot when an emergency actually happens.
